title: BJ - Better Java
description: Better Java makes your game run smoother and more fancy!
body: Better Java is the ultimate upgrade for your Minecraft world because it perfectly balances top-tier performance optimizations with breathtaking visual enhancements, making your Java edition look beautiful and run smoother than ever before. This modpack features stunning visuals like built-in shader support, improved animations, and enhanced connected textures to make your world look alive, while being powered by industry-standard optimization mods to give you high FPS, even with high-end graphics enabled. It also includes handpicked YouTube hidden gems featuring highly recommended mods from popular showcases to truly elevate your gameplay and deliver the definitive Java experience that keeps the core gameplay you love while making everything look and feel modern. Please note that the cool custom loading screen will only appear from the second time you launch the game, so do not worry if you do not see it on your very first startup. This pack is deeply inspired by amazing community projects like Fabulously Optimized and various YouTube mod showcases, and all mods used in this pack belong to their respective creators and are downloaded directly through the official Modrinth ecosystem.
